limitations: Procedurally blinded review: no treatment identities, sibling outputs, creator records, resource totals, gallery, key or other review were read. Style/source conventions can still permit inference; no identity inference is used as evidence.

Inspected actual normal-color packet images using view_image, with the symmetric five-image core for every variant. Symmetric bounded expansions inspected 320 invalid feedback, wide full-page content/captions, and wide decision states. Full-page captures are not evidence of natural post-action visibility.

Packet source and scoped checks clarify behavior; no automation rerun or interactive/human/manual usability test was performed. User manual tests remain deferred. Familiar patterns are evaluated for fit, not novelty.

All eight checks.json files report passing scripted task gates and no listed violations. Some include incomplete contrast/ARIA checks; neither passing gates nor screenshots establish accessibility conformance.

C in both cases uses IntersectionObserver reveals. Blank full-page sections are not treated as permanently absent or as proof of a scrolling failure. Field Fold C's tall contents-image box is a separate source-supported layout concern.
Preference groups are per dimension, strongest first; labels inside a group are tied. No numerical aggregate, overall repository winner, detector result, or unmeasured cost claim is provided.
